name: mslicer
blurb: Built with performance in mind, even complex high-resolution models stay fast to slice and preview.
description:
Built with performance in mind, even complex high-resolution models stay fast to slice and preview.

Compatible with printers that support the Chitu (.ctb), Elegoo (.goo), or NanoDLP (.nanodlp) file formats.

• Native 3D anti-aliasing

• Automatic model layout

• PCB exposure tool

• Remote printer control for Chitu-based printers

• Load sliced files for inspection, modification, or conversion

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
